create.name: WCCM Nederland (Christelijke Meditatie Nederland)
create.bio:
WCCM Nederland is the Dutch foundation that represents the World Community for Christian Meditation in the Netherlands. It passes on the way of prayer taught by the Benedictine monk John Main, who drew on the early Christian desert monks: a daily period of silent, still sitting in which the meditator returns again and again to a single prayer word, usually maranatha. The foundation is legally independent but shares the aims and structure of the international community, and its board is led by a national coordinator.

Most of its life happens in small weekly groups that meet in churches and homes across the country, many of them welcoming newcomers without any membership. Nationally it holds a yearly day of talks and workshops and a silent Advent retreat at a monastery. Online, it publishes a step-by-step guide to meditating, a series of weekly teaching letters in Dutch, a fortnightly reflection by email, a group finder and seasonal material for Lent and Advent.
